Two departures from the repo's node-side packages, both properties of where this code runs: `DOM`, because the pages execute in a browser (08-OFFCHAIN §3), and `resolveJsonModule`, because a statically-hosted build has to carry its contract address at build time — there is no server to ask at request time. Resolution is `bundler` rather than `NodeNext` because Next resolves the graph, and `lib/` typechecks the same under both.
